Show all patients monitored by devices
Are there any acute conditions in the system
List all medical devices and their IDs
Show all observations with heart rate value greater than 100
Get all feedback submitted by patients with their text
Count how many devices each patient is using
query: PREFIX : <http://www.semanticweb.org/patient_monitoring#> SELECT ?p (COUNT(?d) AS ?devCount) WHERE { ?p :isMonitoredBy ?d . } GROUP BY ?p

question: Find all acute conditions and optional severity level
Is there any patient older than 80
List top 5 observations ordered by timestamp descending
query: PREFIX : <http://www.semanticweb.org/patient_monitoring#> SELECT ?obs ?time WHERE { ?obs a :Observation ; :timestamp ?time . } ORDER BY DESC(?time) LIMIT 5

question: Find patients who have both a device and an acute condition
Show average age of all patients
Get all devices that have no assigned patient
query: PREFIX : <http://www.semanticweb.org/patient_monitoring#> SELECT ?d WHERE { ?d a :MedicalDevice . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?p :isMonitoredBy ?d . } }
